name: supersurf
description: MCP browser automation for autonomous AI agents

scripts.build.cli: npm run build.shared && cd cli && npm run build
scripts.build.shim: cd server/shim && go build -o ../bin/$(go env GOOS)-$(go env GOARCH)/supersurf-shim .
scripts.build: npm run build.shared && npm run build.engine && npm run build.daemon && npm run build.server && npm run build.extension
scripts.test.cli: cd cli && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: npm run test.shared && npm run test.engine && npm run test.daemon && npm run test.server && npm run test.cli && npm run test.extension && npm run test.scripts && npm run test.shim && npm run smoke.register && npm run smoke.hints && npm run smoke.parallel && npm run smoke.restart
scripts.mcp: claude mcp add supersurf -- node server/dist/cli.js
